name: EBALDC VITA
fullDescription: East Bay Asian Local Development Corporation (EBALDC) hosts free tax preparation each tax season through the IRS VITA program for low-income individuals and families in Oakland, paired with a savings initiative.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free tax preparation
- Federal and state returns
- Help with tax credits (EITC, CalEITC)
- IRS-certified volunteer preparers
- Savings Initiative that encourages saving part of your refund
howToGetIt:
1. Check the EBALDC VITA page for the upcoming tax season schedule (sites are closed between seasons)
2. Email sparkpoint@ebaldc.org with questions
3. Make an appointment when sites open
4. Bring required tax documents
5. Complete your tax filing
keywords: EBALDC, East Bay Asian Local Development, SparkPoint Oakland, VITA, free tax preparation, EITC, CalEITC, multilingual, Oakland
